name: Write and debug C language programs
description: Users asked for C language programs to solve a diverse range of algorithmic, systems-level, and computational tasks, including implementing data structures, handling file I/O, managing concurrency, and performing mathematical calculations. Many requests involved writing specific utility tools, such as calculators, schedulers, and string manipulators, or debugging existing C code to meet precise functional requirements.
